policies.editions: Full same-name bilingual text, printed stats, power tags and every gameplay tag equal; only explicit set and deck-copy tags differ. Retain each original ID/dbf/set/full metadata. Named CORE definitions and callbacks are reused without entity/source substitution or a second resolver.
policies.native_declarations: Original Mayor registers its own ordinary random-target marker; original Khadgar uses exact native summon quantity declaration; Alakir uses actual four printed keywords.
policies.callbacks: Existing accepted attack/power/draw/shield facts, guarded destroy-health reward, physical hand/deck summons, deck destruction, previous-owner-turn recovery, real named Lynx refill and two-keyword choice keep their actual generic source IDs and public kernels.
policies.mograine: An independent original-card program clones every existing functional profile field, changes only program ID and printed source card; actual source allocation/health provenance, permanent instances and ordinary end-turn damage remain shared.

uncertainties: Existing exact draw-copy, declaration order, future-source, random-target, summon-capacity and previous-turn policies remain local where not CN-calibrated.
Existing counterparts and actual named Lynx are pinned complete existing dependencies; no newly fetched CORE/child primary face claim.
Full past732 and other incomplete source domains remain unbound; no implemented-subset generation pool, current patch/hotfix alignment or CN calibration claim.
